Each model is projected independently. An outright party majority requires 51 seats. Independent/other seats remain unassigned to either party. The fixed baseline is 32 Democratic, 31 Republican and 2 independent seats. Synthetic models allocate 35 contests using the largest average voting-category probability, excluding Would not vote. Polling Forecast allocates each contest to its implied two-candidate leader; ties stay unallocated. Synthetic results, not measured voter intentions.
